column3: “the skillful persons” renders “the wise of heart,” and “endowed with” renders “filled with.”
“the skillfully woven band” renders “hesheb,” the band (also in verses 27–28), and “of the same material” renders “from it.”
“according to their birth” renders “according to their generations (toledot).”
“As a jeweler engraves a signet” renders “the work of an engraver of stone, engravings of a seal.”
“mount” renders “fill”; the identification of the gems in verses 17–20 is uncertain.
“a diamond” renders “yahalom,” a stone whose identity is uncertain.
“a beryl” renders “tarshish,” a stone whose identity is uncertain.
